page_title: WOL 0-0 LEV | Wolfsburg v Bayer Leverkusen 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Caution goes to Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg).
90+6' Golden chance! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
90+4' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
90+3' Emiliano Buendia (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Bayer Leverkusen earn a corner.
90+3' We are about to witness a subsitution. Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) for Kilian Fischer.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Patrick Wimmer is going off and Ralph Hasenhuttl gives the last tactical orders to Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg).
90' The substitution has been made. Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) has replaced Jonas Wind.
90' Substitution. Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) has come on for Mattias Svanberg.

86' A big opportunity is wasted by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the bottom right corner. Unfortunately for him, Lukas Hradecky pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
86' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
84' A pass into space is latched onto by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen), and he bends a shot just wide of the right post that had the keeper worried.
83' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Bayer Leverkusen win a corner. The ball is cleared after Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
80' The Bayer Leverkusen players can’t believe it after referee Sascha Stegemann signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
78' Referee Sascha Stegemann makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
77' The attendance for today's match is 27000.
77' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) was probably a bit loose with his words to Sascha Stegemann, who decides to show him a yellow.
77' PENALTY APPEAL after Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
76' Here's the change. Nathan Tella leaves the pitch and Emiliano Buendia (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.
75' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Victor Boniface.
75' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) shows his willingness to get forward and blasts a shot towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the shot isn't precise enough and hits the crossbar!
75' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is yellow-carded.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) comes onto the pitch for Tiago Tomas.
70' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
69' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
60' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Aleix Garcia will be replaced by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen).
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Arthur walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen).
59' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
59' Bayer Leverkusen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

59' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

57' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) receives the ball and fires a first-time shot from long range. His brilliant effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Lukas Hradecky, who pulls off a stunning save!
55' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marius Muller, who smothers the ball.
54' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen).
52' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

52' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen). The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
50' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
48' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the bottom right corner of the net.
48' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
47' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45+3' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Bayer Leverkusen will have a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
43' That was close by Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.

42' What a wasted opportunity by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Lukas Hradecky makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
40' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
37' It's like he was asking for a caution. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a yellow card.
35' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
34' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) will take a corner kick.
33' What a chance! Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) rises high to meet the corner and plants a fine header goalwards, but the goalkeeper is alert and pulls off an astonishing reflex save.
33' Corner kick. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity.
32' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
30' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
27' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes.
22' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar.
21' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayer Leverkusen are going to take it.
21' A lofted cross from Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
20' Mario Hermoso (Bayer Leverkusen) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
17' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) aims his free kick effort towards the middle of the goal, but Lukas Hradecky is well prepared and makes a good block to stop the ball from crossing the goal line.
15' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Sascha Stegemann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
13' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayer Leverkusen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Wolfsburg players look gutted.
7' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Wolfsburg players aren’t happy.

7' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space inside the box to meet the free kick and powers a perfectly placed header into the top right corner of the goal.
4' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Wolfsburg will take the kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann will referee today's match.
